title: Me → Claude → Claude models (out of tokens)
story: The same six storm loops, now on Claude Haiku and Sonnet through the router: real Anthropic tokens and cost, next to the open-weight runs. This first try gave each call 300 output tokens: Claude 5.5 spent them reasoning and returned empty answers (3 of 32 valid). Re-run at 1500.

source.workload: the storm site's scheduled datasets, read over its public API

metrics.not_measured: the A3 runner's own Claude tokens (its Claude Code session): not exposed to the run
